labs.question: Do unchanged native guard, directional dodge and seal responses have distinct timing, range, resource and early-counter envelopes under the same phase-one sweep trace?
Can controlled defective and reference artifacts detect the intended behavior without leaking evaluator context or inventing model-performance claims?
Which bounded resource ownership and expenditure rules produce distinct viable choices under matched scenarios?
Can a player understand the costs of a consequential choice while characters retain distinct motives and continuity?
Which visual and audio cues expose contact, commitment and recovery without obscuring the character or threat?
Which command, retry and recovery contracts preserve accepted progress under bounded failures without trusting client state?
